notes: Example configuration generated by the CraneCalc configurator; fictitious crane, supplier, site and owner data, to be replaced with project data. Scope: 3 continuous 15-ft bays, W12X53 girders, one 3-ton pendant crane, on new freestanding W14X120 columns with welded twin-rib bracket seats, base plates, anchor rods and spread footings, and crane-level rod X-bracing; the existing building carries no crane load. Seismic: ordinary steel cantilever column system across the runway and rod bracing not specifically detailed for seismic resistance along it, Seismic Design Category B. Bumper overhang assumed 20 in (end-wheel centerline to the extended bumper face, a typical supplier proportion): the stop contact positions use it; confirm with the crane supplier. The bracket stays: the W8X31 crane-level strut is moment-connected in plan at every column by 13 mm plates on its flanges (torsion brace, 2 rows of bolt pairs) and holds the new W14X120 columns against the twist: 0.0054 rad factored (limit 0.02) and 1 mm of bearing movement at every crane start and stop (limit 18 mm). The strut is sized so the girder's twist movement under the factored traction, 2 mm, is within 3 mm (a configurator target, the TR-13 alignment tolerance class, not a code limit). With the strut on the column centerline alone, the girder seated 641 mm off the column axis, the traction twists the column 0.2922 rad factored (limit 0.02) and 56 mm of bearing movement at every crane start and stop (limit 18 mm).

fabrication.steel: Girder ASTM A992; plates, bars and stiffeners ASTM A572 Grade 50 unless noted.
fabrication.bolting: ASTM F3125 Grade A325, pretensioned, Class B faying surfaces, standard holes unless slots are detailed. Sliding-end bearing bolts and column-end tie bolts pretensioned against steel sleeves. Rail joints thermite or flash-butt welded by the rail supplier's qualified procedure (preheat, grinding, inspection); no joint bars or bolts.
fabrication.welding: E70XX low-hydrogen electrodes per AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020, cyclically loaded provisions. Continuous fillets as dimensioned; no intermittent welds on cyclic load paths. Smooth starts and stops.
fabrication.inspection: Visual inspection of all welds; AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020 cyclically loaded acceptance criteria; magnetic particle testing of fillets at fatigue-sensitive attachments; 100% ultrasonic testing of CJP welds; bolt pretension verification per RCSC.
fabrication.erection: Set and level the bearings, install the end bearings and flange ties, then set the rails. Provide temporary restraint until the permanent ties are complete.
fabrication.railAlignment: Set the rails to the specified gauge, alignment and level tolerances and survey them after erection, before the load test.
